#### Set-up

```{r, include=FALSE}
library(knitr)
```

```{r}
library(RSQLite)
library(DBI)

# Initialize a temporary in memory database
con <- dbConnect(SQLite(), ":memory:")

# Download tables
actor <- read.csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ivanceras/sakila/master/csv-sakila-db/actor.csv")
rental <- read.csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ivanceras/sakila/master/csv-sakila-db/rental.csv")
customer <- read.csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ivanceras/sakila/master/csv-sakila-db/customer.csv")
payment <- read.csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ivanceras/sakila/master/csv-sakila-db/payment_p2007_01.csv")

# Copy data.frames to database
dbWriteTable(con, "actor", actor)
dbWriteTable(con, "rental", rental)
dbWriteTable(con, "customer", customer)
dbWriteTable(con, "payment", payment)
```

``` sql
dbListTables(con)
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
kable(
  data.frame(table_name = dbListTables(con)),
  caption = "List of Tables in the Database",
  align = "c"
)
```

``` sql
PRAGMA table_info(actor)
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
kable(
  dbGetQuery(con, "PRAGMA table_info(actor)"),
  caption = "Structure of the 'actor' Table",
  align = "c"
)
```

### Exercise 1

``` sql
SELECT actor_id, first_name, last_name
FROM actor
ORDER BY last_name, first_name
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
kable(head(dbGetQuery(con, "
    SELECT actor_id, first_name, last_name
    FROM actor
    ORDER BY last_name, first_name
  "), 10),
  caption = "First 10 Actors Ordered by Last and First Name",
  align = "c")
```

### Exercise 2

``` sql
SELECT actor_id, first_name, last_name
FROM actor
WHERE last_name IN ('WILLIAMS', 'DAVIS')
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
kable(dbGetQuery(con, "
  SELECT actor_id, first_name, last_name
  FROM actor
  WHERE last_name IN ('WILLIAMS', 'DAVIS')"))
```

### Exercise 5

``` sql
SELECT payment.payment_id, payment.amount
FROM payment
  INNER JOIN customer ON payment.customer_id = customer.customer_id
WHERE customer.last_name = 'DAVIS'
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
kable(head(dbGetQuery(con, "
    SELECT payment.payment_id, payment.amount
    FROM payment
    INNER JOIN customer ON payment.customer_id = customer.customer_id
    WHERE customer.last_name = 'DAVIS'
  "), 10),
  caption = "Payments Made by Customer Last Name DAVIS",
  align = "c")
```

### Exercise 6.3

``` sql

FROM rental

ORDER BY rental_count DESC
```

### Exercise 6.4

``` sql
SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS rental_count
FROM rental
GROUP BY customer_id
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 40
ORDER BY rental_count DESC
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
kable(head(dbGetQuery(con, "
    SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS rental_count
    FROM rental
    GROUP BY customer_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 40
    ORDER BY rental_count DESC
  "), 10),
  caption = "Top Customers with 40 or More Rentals",
  align = "c")
```

### Exercise 7.0

``` sql
SELECT 
  MAX(amount) AS max_amount,
  MIN(amount) AS min_amount,
  AVG(amount) AS avg_amount,
  SUM(amount) AS sum_amount
FROM payment
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
kable(dbGetQuery(con, "
    SELECT 
      MAX(amount) AS max_amount,
      MIN(amount) AS min_amount,
      AVG(amount) AS avg_amount,
      SUM(amount) AS sum_amount
    FROM payment
  "),
  caption = "Summary Statistics for Payment Amounts",
  align = "c")
```

### Exercise 7.2

``` sql

```

